caption: The drawing shows a single, centrally placed object that resembles a rounded, cylindrical base or plinth. The object is rendered in grayscale pencil, and it has a flared base with a series of evenly spaced, parallel grooves circling the bottom edge. Above this section, the body of the object slightly narrows as it ascends, before flaring out again near the top. The upper rim features a decorative pattern consisting of a series of oval or petal-like shapes accentuated by shading, followed by a narrow, smooth inner ring circling an empty central cavity. The background consists of an unadorned, lightly textured, off-white surface, and the drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline. In the lower right corner, the name "Amelia Tuccio" and the year "1931" are written in neat handwriting.
title: Silver Salt Trencher
